title: The Fish Come Back

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: Hello there! Look: the ice has melted, and the fish are back in the shallows!

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: This morning's catch is for the families in the valley. Four fish in each basket, please.

steps.speaker: finn
steps.prompt: Put four fish in each basket. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a basket with an empty dip, and put a fish there.

older.prompt: Six fish in each basket, four baskets. No dips: count them yourself.

feedback.full: That basket's full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four baskets of four: sixteen fish! Spring is here.

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: Sixteen fish, and the sun on the water. The lake's woken up from its long winter sleep!

journal_line: I counted the first spring fish into baskets with Mr. Finn.

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: Four baskets of six: twenty-four fish! The lake's woken up from its long winter sleep.
